{{Recipe summary
| Category = Pet recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

These '''dog biscuits''' have a bit of protein from peanut butter and some abrasiveness from bran flakes and oats. You can use a mostly-oat low-fat granola in place of just the oats and the kind of bran cereal with flax seeds in for some extra texture.

==Ingredients==
*1 beaten [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 4.1 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) chicken or vegetable [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]
*¼ cup (60 ml / 2 fl oz) [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]
*¼ cup (75 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 2.6 oz) [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]
*about 1 cup (140 g / 4.9 oz) [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]
*¾ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) bran [[Cookbook:Breakfast Cereal|cereal]]
*¼ cup (20 g / 0.71 oz) rolled [[Cookbook:Oats|oats]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to {{convert|350|F|C}}.
# Mix the peanut butter, stock, and oil into the egg until smooth.
# Mix the flour, cereal and oats together.
# Add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture until it forms a very stiff [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] (you'll need to use your hands at the end). If not very stiff, add more flour gradually.
# Turn the dough out onto a lightly-floured surface and roll to about {{convert|0.25|in|mm}} thick. Cut out shapes (bone shapes work well).
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] biscuits on a lightly-greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]] in the middle oven rack for about 15 minutes.
# For best results, allow biscuits to harden overnight.
